title: Quarters, from route to tiered category cards
summary: The `/quarters` route is a one-line server shim onto `QuartersIndex`. That client component loads two feeds — the owned/loose state model and the composition's runtimes — decides single-runtime (the classic Claude Code grid) versus multi-runtime (a collapsible section per engine), and renders one card per category. The category list and its tier labels come from the static `QUARTERS_CATEGORIES` descriptor, and each Claude Code card's owned/loose counts are rolled up from `primitive-state`.

states.label: Quarters
states.description: The drillbook asks that the landing clearly explain runtime configuration tiers and present every runtime/category card with balanced spacing and obvious next actions. It is the `/quarters` route, and the whole surface renders from one client component that lists the Claude Code categories over the real `~/.claude`.

steps.title: The route is a shim onto QuartersIndex
steps.description: Navigating to `/quarters` lands on a server component that does nothing but mount `QuartersIndex`. There is no data-loading in the route itself — the entire landing is a client component that fetches what it needs on mount — which is why the route file is five lines long.

steps.title: Two feeds load on mount: state model and runtimes
steps.description: On mount the index fires two fetches in parallel. `/api/quarters` returns the owned/loose `StateModel` used for the per-card counts; `/api/quarters/runtimes` (scoped to the `?composition=` param) returns the runtimes the composition selected, and that feed is what decides whether the page shows the single classic grid or a section per engine.

steps.title: Header explains the tiers; one flag picks the layout
steps.description: The head copy is the tier explanation the drillbook asks for — Claude Code over the real `~/.claude`, other engines a generic tier. Below the InstallBanner, `multi` (more than one configurable runtime) is the single flag that branches the render: not-multi paints the classic Claude Code grid by mapping `QUARTERS_CATEGORIES` into `CategoryCard`s; multi renders a collapsible section per engine instead.

steps.title: The category list and its tier labels are a static descriptor
steps.description: The ten cards — Settings, Context, Skills, Hooks, MCPs, Plugins, Scripts, Plans, Logs, Sessions (plus AgentSDK) — are not computed; they are the ordered `QUARTERS_CATEGORIES` constant, the single source of truth shared by the sidebar, the index, and the `[type]` route validator. Each entry carries the `writer` tier (apm / garrison / split / readonly) that the card renders as its pill, so the tier a category belongs to is declared here, not in the component.

steps.title: Owned vs loose is the state model each card rolls up
steps.description: For a `primitives`-kind category the card shows owned/loose badges — the drillbook's "obvious next action" cue for what Garrison manages versus what is hand-authored. `owned` means the primitive is a package file APM tracks in the global lock; `loose` means it exists on disk under `~/.claude` but is not in the lock. `computeStateModel` scans disk and diffs each file against the lock to set exactly that state, and the index sums it per surface into the badge counts.
